title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.1 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 10:07 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 18:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 695 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Sunny's hair would be a mess right now. ☀️🌌👀

Several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal-hole-like structure are visible today, with no clear large outward feature in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
